description.en: Rav Yirmeyah b. Abba was a devoted student of Rav and later studied under Shmuel.
description.he: רבי ירמיה בר אבא היה תלמיד מסור של רב. מאוחר יותר בחייו למד אצל שמואל.

charLevelData.text: Rebbi267This must be “Rav”. He is the early Amora Rav Jeremiah bar Abba, presenting a tradition of R. Yose the Tanna. He might be one of the editors of R. Yose’s Seder ‘Olam; cf. the author’s Introduction (pp. x–xi) to hisedition of Seder ‘Olam (Northvale 1998). Jeremiah bar Abba
